identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC][defect] Recover and classify preserved failed issue projections

values.task_boundary: Issue #297 recovery subsystem and proving tests only; no #296/#294/#291 product mutation, merge, or closeout.
deliverables: Typed read-only classification inventory with exact candidate identities, manifests, and disposition
Typed immutable-ledger recovery that restores a verified canonical projection and archives rejected evidence
Separate exact-identity cleanup operation with evidence-preserving receipts
Crash/restart, collision, symlink, race, CAS, topology, corruption, ambiguity, idempotency, and subsequent-commit proof
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Classify inventories canonical, backup, preserved, and active attempts without mutation and emits exact identities, manifests, validity, and disposition
AC-2: Recover restores exactly one verified prior projection while preserving rejected evidence and append-only recovery provenance
AC-3: Collisions, dangling symlinks, hardlink aliases, and post-preflight races cannot install or delete an unauthorized inode
AC-4: Recovery is restart-idempotent across every rename and parent-directory fsync boundary
AC-5: A complete recovery permits a later ordinary typed commit; incomplete or ambiguous attempts still fail closed
AC-6: Cleanup is separate, exact receipt/identity/manifest/CAS/topology guarded, and never removes unclassified or unrelated content
AC-7: Corruption, namespace mismatch, stale CAS, wrong worktree/branch, and multiple plausible candidates fail closed without partial mutation
AC-8: Existing initialized/ready recovery and issue #291 semantics remain unchanged
AC-9: Issue #296 remains blocked until #297 is terminal and ancestral
non_goals: Automatic evidence deletion or general recursive cleanup
Lifecycle rollback, phase rewriting, or audit rewriting
